recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the work group wants Composition.relatesTo targets to become mandatory document-bundle contents in the future, handle that as a new substantive decision rather than as unfinished FHIR-19711 work.
issue_request: FHIR-19711 was Published and resolved Persuasive for STU3. It asked to replace broad wording saying any resource referenced directly in Composition SHALL be included in a document bundle because that seemed to include Composition.relatesTo, while the explicit generated list did not.
initial_application: Git commit 84b04d276f340dfea2c181d0d211d7b5e0234654 (GF#19711) applied the issue by replacing the broad sentence in source/documents.html with the approved listed-reference wording. Current source/documents.html still contains that wording.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes documents.html in the active build hierarchy. The current built page expands the Composition reference list without Composition.relatesTo. Later related commits for FHIR-15723, FHIR-27891, and FHIR-43295 adjusted surrounding document-bundle guidance without reversing this issue; FHIR-15760 is already represented on the combined branch as a related audit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active source contains the approved sentence and the generated/current build output preserves the issue's intended distinction by omitting relatesTo from the required Composition reference list.
